description: Daily web puzzle game — inventory tetris with alchemically reactive reagents

tasks.title: Add adjacency detection to MetaGrid
tasks.description: Add methods to MetaGrid: GetAdjacentCells(Vector2I) returns cardinal neighbor cells (up/down/left/right) that exist in the grid. GetAdjacentReagents(Reagent) returns distinct reagents occupying cells adjacent to any cell of the given reagent. Add comprehensive unit tests in tests/AlchemistCourier.Core.Tests/Grid/MetaGridTests.cs covering: empty grid, single reagent (no neighbors), two adjacent reagents, diagonal-only (not adjacent), reagent adjacent to itself (excluded), multiple neighbors.
tasks.verification: dotnet test — new adjacency tests pass, existing 47 tests still pass

tasks.title: Add ReactionRule and ReactionResult data models
tasks.description: Create src/Core/Chemistry/ReactionRule.cs and ReactionResult.cs. ReactionRule: TriggerAspects (list of aspect names that must be co-present), SensitivityTier enum (Adjacent, SameBag, WholeInventory), Granularity enum (PerCell, PerItem), Threshold (int, for cumulative rules — 0 means any contact triggers), ResultType (ReactionResultType enum). ReactionResult: Type (Explosion, Neutralization, Breakage, StatusEffect, Overheating, Hypothermia, Poisoning), Magnitude (float), AffectedCells (list of Vector2I), SourceRule (reference to the ReactionRule that triggered it). Add ReactionResultType enum. These are pure data models — no logic yet. Verify dotnet build succeeds.
tasks.verification: dotnet build succeeds with zero errors

tasks.title: Add reaction rule database
tasks.description: Create src/Core/Chemistry/ReactionRuleDatabase.cs — a static class providing GetMvpRules() returning List<ReactionRule> with the Physical/Chemistry school rules from docs/chemistry-system.md: Hot+Volatile=Explosion (Adjacent), Hot+Cold=Neutralization (SameBag), Sharp+Fragile=Breakage (Adjacent), Toxic+Toxic=ToxicCloud (SameBag), cumulative Hot threshold (Overheating, threshold=4, WholeInventory), cumulative Cold threshold (Hypothermia, threshold=4, WholeInventory), cumulative Toxic threshold (Poisoning, threshold=3, WholeInventory). Also add GetRulesForAspects(string aspect1, string aspect2) lookup method. Add unit tests verifying: correct number of rules returned, specific rule lookups work, threshold values are correct.
tasks.verification: dotnet test — rule database tests pass

tasks.title: Add ChemistryEngine evaluator
tasks.description: Create src/Core/Chemistry/ChemistryEngine.cs with static method Evaluate(MetaGrid, List<ReactionRule>) returning List<ReactionResult>. Implementation: (1) For each adjacency rule, iterate all placed reagents, check adjacent reagents for matching trigger aspects. (2) For each same-bag rule, iterate all bags, check reagents in the same bag for matching aspects. (3) For each cumulative rule, sum aspect magnitudes across the whole inventory and check against threshold. Add comprehensive unit tests: empty grid (no reactions), two hot+volatile reagents adjacent (explosion), hot+volatile separated by gap (no reaction), cumulative heat exceeding threshold (overheating), hot+cold in same bag (neutralization), mixed scenario with multiple reactions.
tasks.verification: dotnet test — chemistry evaluation tests pass

tasks.title: Add prospective evaluation
tasks.description: Add static method to ChemistryEngine: EvaluateProspective(MetaGrid, Reagent, Vector2I, List<ReactionRule>) returning List<ReactionResult>. This temporarily places the reagent at the given position, evaluates, then removes it — returning what WOULD happen without mutating the grid. Implementation: clone or use temporary placement. Add unit tests: prospective place in safe spot (empty results), prospective place adjacent to volatile (explosion result), verify grid is unchanged after call.
tasks.verification: dotnet test — prospective evaluation tests pass, grid unchanged after call

tasks.title: Add SeededRandom deterministic RNG
tasks.description: Create src/Core/SeededRandom.cs — a deterministic random number generator. Constructor takes int seed. Methods: Next() returns int, Next(max) returns 0..max-1, Next(min, max) returns min..max-1, NextFloat() returns 0.0..1.0, Shuffle<T>(List<T>) shuffles in place. Use System.Random internally (it's deterministic given a seed in .NET). Add unit tests: same seed produces same sequence, different seeds produce different sequences, Shuffle is deterministic, Next(min,max) stays in range.
tasks.verification: dotnet test — determinism tests pass

tasks.title: Add PuzzleState and DifficultyParams data models
tasks.description: Create src/Core/Puzzle/PuzzleState.cs and DifficultyParams.cs. PuzzleState: Seed (int), Difficulty (DifficultyLevel enum: Tutorial1-Tutorial5, Easy, Medium, Hard), PuzzleType (enum: FitAllSafely, MaximizeValue, MeetRequirement), Bags (list of bag definitions with grid positions), Reagents (list of reagent definitions), Placements (list of {reagentIndex, position, rotation} — current player state), Solution (list of {reagentIndex, position, rotation} — the valid answer). DifficultyParams: BagCount, BagMinSize, BagMaxSize, ReagentCount, MaxAspectCount, SpareSpacePercent, AllowSpecialBags. Add JSON serialization round-trip unit test (serialize PuzzleState to JSON string, deserialize back, verify equality).
tasks.verification: dotnet test — serialization round-trip test passes

tasks.title: Add PuzzleGenerator
tasks.description: Create src/Core/Puzzle/PuzzleGenerator.cs implementing the disassemble-a-solution algorithm from docs/mvp-specification.md. Method: Generate(int seed, DifficultyParams) returning PuzzleState. Algorithm: (1) Create SeededRandom from seed. (2) Generate bags based on difficulty. (3) Generate reagents with aspects based on difficulty. (4) Place reagents into bags following rules (using ChemistryEngine to validate no negative reactions). (5) Record solution. (6) Remove reagents to create puzzle. Start simple: rectangular bags only, 1-2 cell reagents, basic aspects. Add unit tests: generated puzzle has non-empty bags and reagents, solution is valid (ChemistryEngine returns no negative reactions when solution is applied), same seed produces same puzzle.
tasks.verification: dotnet test — puzzle generation tests pass, solution validates

tasks.title: Add PuzzleSolver / validator
tasks.description: Create src/Core/Puzzle/PuzzleSolver.cs with static method ValidateSolution(PuzzleState) returning bool. Checks: all reagents placed, no overlaps, all placements within bag bounds, ChemistryEngine returns no negative reactions. Also add IsSolvable(PuzzleState) that tries the stored solution. Add unit tests: valid solution validates, solution with overlap fails, solution with reaction fails, empty placement fails.
tasks.verification: dotnet test — solver validation tests pass

tasks.title: Implement Stable aspect buffering mechanic
tasks.description: The MVP spec lists Stable as a minimum aspect, but it's missing from PuzzleGenerator.MvpAspects and has no ChemistryEngine support. Three changes needed: (1) Add 'stable' to PuzzleGenerator.MvpAspects array. (2) Add threshold-raising logic to ChemistryEngine — when evaluating a reaction rule, check if any Stable cell is adjacent to the involved cells; if so, increase the effective threshold by the Stable magnitude. (3) Add unit tests: Stable adjacent to Hot+Volatile pair should suppress Explosion (threshold raised above 0), Stable not adjacent should not suppress, multiple Stable cells should stack. Without this, the core buffering mechanic is absent and puzzles lack strategic depth.
tasks.verification: dotnet test — Stable buffering tests pass, PuzzleGenerator can produce puzzles with Stable reagents
